title: 6.4.18 A15.1 Side-Scrolling Platformer
description: Combine animated sprites, a camera that follows the player, three or more platforms, working jump mechanics, and a visible end goal into a playable side-scroller. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Create the player with an initial visual
steps.instructions: In setup(), create the player sprite. Give it an initial visual — either addAni('idle', ...) or sprite.image = '🧍'.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Visual / image section. Single emoji strings work as zero-asset placeholders.

steps.title: Build a level wider than the canvas
steps.instructions: In setup(), create at least three static platforms ('static' as the 5th constructor argument) plus a ground. Spread them across an x-range wider than the canvas so the level requires scrolling.
hints: The Sprite constructor's 5th argument controls physics type. Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Sprite section.

steps.title: Place a visible end goal
steps.instructions: In setup(), add a goal sprite far to the right. Give it sprite.collider = 'none' so it doesn't physically push the player away.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and find the Visual / image section for the goal's appearance.

steps.title: Clear the background each frame
steps.instructions: In draw(), call background(...) so old frames don't pile up.
hints: Search the shplay docs drawer for background().

steps.title: WASD movement + state-driven visual swap
steps.instructions: In draw(), read WASD with kb.pressing. Set the player's horizontal motion AND swap its visual based on motion — sprite.image to a 'run' emoji when moving, back to 'idle' when not. The grader looks for at least two animation states inside draw().
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer's Input / Keyboard section for kb.pressing.

steps.title: Ground-gated jump
steps.instructions: In draw(), use kb.presses('w') (edge-triggered) AND player.colliding(allSprites) together to jump only when the player is touching the ground or a platform.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer's Sprite section for colliding/overlaps. kb.presses fires once per press; kb.pressing fires every frame the key is held.

steps.title: Camera follows the player
steps.instructions: In draw(), assign camera.x from player.x every frame so the canvas tracks the player. The hard follow line is fine; lerp smoothing is a stretch.
hints: See the camera examples 2.4.8 and 2.4.9 if you're stuck.

steps.title: Goal overlap + win message
steps.instructions: In draw(), check player.overlaps(goal). When it's truthy, call text('You win!', ...) so the win message is what the overlap triggers.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer's Sprite section for overlaps. text() is the global drawing function for on-canvas text.

requirements.title: Two or more animation states
requirements.description: Either two addAni registrations, OR two assignments to sprite.image with different values.

requirements.title: Camera follows the player
requirements.description: Inside draw(), assign camera.x from a sprite's x (or use lerp with both).

requirements.title: Three or more static platforms
requirements.description: Create at least three static sprites — either three direct calls to new Sprite(..., 'static') OR a for-loop body that creates a 'static' sprite inside it.

requirements.title: Working ground-gated jump
requirements.description: Inside draw(), gate kb.presses(jump key) on .colliding(...) inside a single condition (e.g. `kb.presses('w') && player.colliding(allSprites)`) so the player can only jump when touching ground or a platform.

requirements.title: Goal detection + win message
requirements.description: Inside draw(), call .overlaps(goal) and follow it with a text(...) call (within ~200 chars) so the win message is what the overlap triggers.
